requirements.name: Relevant degree or demonstrated equivalent

lines.quote: Designed and executed a benchmarking protocol comparing factory-set calibration against in-field optical sensor readings across three detector variants, tracking drift over a six-month period
my degree is in biological engineering rather than electrical engineering or physics, and I have one employer on my CV. These are real gaps.
